result.instructions: Avito MCP — a server for the live (production) Avito API. Before any write/money/public operation, always confirm the action with a human; in confirmation_mode=money_public (default) the server returns a confirmation_id and requires a meta_confirm_action call. Full reference on the safety modes is in the avito://docs/safety resource. The list of tools with their risk classification is in avito://manifest. Pending actions are in avito://state/pending-actions (you can subscribe via resources/subscribe). Received Avito webhook events (if the receiver is enabled) are in avito://webhook/events (subscribable).

serverInfo.description: 148 tools for the Avito API: listings, messenger, orders, delivery, promotion, autoload, analytics, webhook events. With a safety policy (read_only / guarded / full_access), a confirmation flow for money/public operations, and hard-confirmation via AVITO_MCP_CONFIRMATION_SECRET.

result.description: Avito daily overview for the last 7 days / Ежедневная сводка Avito за последние 7 дней

content.text:
Prepare a daily overview of my Avito account for the last 7 days.

Use these tools (all read-only, no confirmation required):
  1. user_get_user_balance — current wallet balance (real + bonus).
  2. items_get_items_info { status: "active", per_page: 50 } — active listings.
  3. items_post_account_spendings {
       dateFrom: "2026-07-25",
       dateTo:   "2026-08-01",
       spendingTypes: ["all"],
       grouping: "day"
     }

Produce a summary: balance, number of active listings (by status), total spendings for the period broken down by type. No long tables.

— Русский / Russian —

Подготовь ежедневную сводку моего Avito-аккаунта за последние 7 дней.

Используй эти tools (все read-only, не требуют confirmation):
  1. user_get_user_balance — текущий баланс кошелька (real + bonus).
  2. items_get_items_info { status: "active", per_page: 50 } — активные объявления.
  3. items_post_account_spendings {
       dateFrom: "2026-07-25",
       dateTo:   "2026-08-01",
       spendingTypes: ["all"],
       grouping: "day"
     }

Сформируй итог: баланс, количество активных объявлений (по статусам), сумма расходов за период с разбивкой по типам. Без длинных таблиц.
